Bottom fishing and/or trolling is the name of the game. We will target snapper, grouper, triggerfish and any other bottom dwelling fish that may be living there. Depending on the time of year, trolling offers the chance to catch mackerel, mahi, bonita, tuna, or possibly even a sailfish!
